title: Split the two remaining over-cap shell test suites in linux_configuration/tests
objective: Bring test_pacman_wrapper_security.sh (287) and test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh (345) under the repo-wide 250-line cap by moving blocks of checks into sourced libs, with both suites producing byte-identical output to their pre-split runs.
acceptance_criteria: Both entry scripts and all four new libs are at most 250 lines.
Each entry keeps its filename, because .github/workflows/shell-tests.yml runs both suites by filename.
test_pacman_wrapper_security.sh output is byte-identical to a run from a detached worktree at HEAD, exiting 0.
test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh output is byte-identical to the pre-split run, exiting 0.
Every new lib passes shellcheck ALONE, without -x, which is the check that decides whether the seam is real.
No check is changed, deleted, skipped or weakened, and no suppression is added.
No seam falls inside a heredoc: the i3blocks fake-binary setup stays in the entry script for exactly this reason.
Each i3blocks lib function ends in an explicit return 0, so a trailing `|| fail` conditional cannot become the function's return value under set -e.
out_of_scope: Reformatting test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh to satisfy shfmt. It uses 2-space indent and was already shfmt-dirty before this change; the new libs match the style of the code they hold.
Splitting block_compulsive_opening.sh, whose installer copies the running script to /usr/local/bin and would leave an entry script unable to find its libs.
Wiring the file-length pre-commit gate, which must land only once --all already exits 0.
verifier: bash linux_configuration/tests/test_pacman_wrapper_security.sh diffed against the same suite from a detached worktree at HEAD, and bash linux_configuration/tests/test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh diffed against its pre-split run (both expect identical output and exit 0), plus shellcheck on each new lib alone, shellcheck -x on both entries, and pre-commit run --files over every touched file.
